summary: The change implements the task exactly: cl_http_utility=>decode_base64 compiles to a host function that composes DecodeXBase64 with a new nodeutf8.Decode, which I verified against Node exhaustively (all 1-3-byte inputs plus boundary-rich 4-6-byte sequences, 26.3M cases, matching on Node 22/24/26) for maximal-subpart U+FFFD replacement, overlongs, surrogates, >U+10FFFF, truncation and BOM. The DecodeXBase64 switch to UTF-16 code-unit narrowing fixes a latent Node-parity gap for non-ASCII input (verified against Node on 3048 directed+random cases including lone surrogates and padding interactions), and end-to-end ABAP behavior (functional and EXPORTING/RECEIVING call forms, strlen over decoded text) passes through osgo-unit with an independently written test class; all regression suites (go test, semantics.mjs, unit.mjs fixtures) pass and CI/docs are updated in the established style.
